notes.title: Mayflower Entertainment Releases Korean Version of 'Sunny Café' on Steam Today
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Romantic Text Adventure Game "Sunny Café" Korean Version Released on Steam on November 6th.
[*] In addition to thrilling love stories, it also offers a rich array of activities, including Taiwanese coffee history, culture, and mini-games.
[/list]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40683332/a9315e90e6e46606c743069c3cd39e16d6a4686e.jpg[/img]

Maple Flower Entertainment has announced the Korean language update for the text adventure game "Sunny Café," developed by Taiwan-based Game Nobility, following its initial release on Stove Indie. The game, released on Steam today (November 6th), revolves around the youthful romantic stories of main characters centered around a cafe, conveying coffee culture through in-game trivia.

[b]Game Features:[/b]

Unique Theme: While the game's theme is centered around a cafe and romantic stories, players can gain a proper understanding of coffee culture through game content. The focus is on conveying Taiwan's unique coffee culture and evoking memories of youthful romance during college days.

Diverse Gameplay: Through various and enjoyable mini-games within the game, players can learn about the coffee-making process, including bean selection, grinding, and more.

Hidden Background Items: Random items appear in the game's background, and clicking on them reveals nuggets of coffee-related trivia.
